programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Fish Liew: Cesium Fallout (Extended version)
programme.desc: After a fire accident triggers a radiation leakage, the entire city suddenly finds its survival hanging by a thread. In order to tackle the impending catastrophe, expert Simon Fan joins the emergency crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive Cecilia to tackle this catastrophic disaster. With the lives of 7 million people on the line, the fire brigade is tasked with stopping the spread at all costs by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented calamity, will Hong Kong wake up to an overnight annihilation?

programme.title: Fire of Conscience
programme.desc: The investigation of a prostitute homicide brings headstrong, heavy-handed Detective Manfred in an unlikely collaboration with sly, man-of-the-world Inspector Kee from the Narcotics Bureau...

programme.title: Spy Girls
programme.desc: Shih Tzu is a tough journalist; despite, being a tiny lady with 155cm height. All her life, she's been teased about being so tiny. So, she determines to have a tall boyfriend and when she gets married, she can have tall children. She even wishes to name her baby “Giraffe.” As soon as she meets Faifa, the tallest senior in her university, who becomes a dedicated and hardworking Police Officer, she determines to win his heart. Would she be able to excel in her career and make him fall in love with her?

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Yam Chun Kai, is a 60-year-old curmudgeon living alone. Forced into retirement, Uncle Kai reflects on his failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter. As the hopelessness prompts him to end his life, a stray dog named Roast Piggy finds Uncle Kai and leads an animal welfare volunteer, Una Tang, to rescue him-the intelligence and humanity of Roast Piggy change Uncle Kai's attitude towards stray animals. Uncle Kai becomes friends with Una and joins her animal shelter 'Warm Home' as a volunteer, helping the abandoned animals. Una hopes Uncle Kai can take this opportunity to clear the air between him and his daughter Zoie. Just as Uncle Kai's life seems to be getting back on track, several dog poisoning incidents occur in the village he lives in...

programme.title: E3 - What Will Cody Do Today?
programme.desc: What will Cody do today? Every day is a new adventure! He might move to a new house with his family & cat, Pickles. Or maybe he'll find a simple empty cardboard box & use his imagination to turn it into a turtle shell, a drum & a race car! He could go on a hike with JJ & race walnut sailboats, or stay home & sing the ABCs over a big pot of alphabet soup. With Cody, you never know what fun you'll have!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: E6 - Calm Songs & Sweet Dreams!
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some fun adventures & sleepy songs! First, help Twinkle find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck & cow make along the way! Then, Bunny leads Twinkle on an exciting adventure into the forest to find a mysterious box. After a long day of playing, it's time for some sleepy songs. Listen as Mr. Moon sings a soothing lullaby to help Twinkle drift off to sleep for a peaceful night's rest.

programme.title: E1 - A Super Fun Underwater Sing-Along!
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty & a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: E3 - A Big Ocean Clean Up Day!
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up & recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit & slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks & even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: E14 - Jill's August Art-venture
programme.desc: Start an Artsy August building project! Help Baby John and Jack construct a carriage for Princess Jill. Then, join Jill's friends for a princess pampering day and help decorate the stage for a funny sock puppet show!

programme.title: E5 - Volcanic Kingfish / Kingfish
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for kingfish Rick Pollock . They fish the the coast of Newzealand just off a live Volcano, then tragedy strikes…… after the Volcano erupts mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: E4 - Marshawn Lynch
programme.desc: Bear and Super Bowl champion Marshawn Lynch tackle a rugged mountain range that has sharp cliffs and dark chasms; the pair comes face to face with the French Foreign Legion and pursues a wild hog for dinner.

programme.title: E2 - Romania
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite?

When they showed off their money at the bank to their friends, they lost it all during a bank robbery and had to move back to their small flat in the public housing estate. When Bill went for an audition at the TV station, he ran into his ex-girlfriend and got himself into trouble when his wife thought he was having an affair. Later, Bill was notified by the bank that they will be reimbursed for the money they lost in the robbery due to a security breach of the bank...
